svg.aria-label: A terminal session in which the critical-lane gate denies gh pr create until the critical review is recorded
svg.title: The critical-lane gate

text.tspan: gh pr create --base main --title "Add refunds" --body-file body.md
Opening or merging the pull request is blocked: task 2 has no critical review after the last
change. For each, run '…/overdrive/bin/overdrive' review-package --base <task base> --head
HEAD --brief <brief> --lane critical, then dispatch overdrive:critical-reviewer with "Task
<N>" in its description (the guard records the review when it is dispatched).
# the guard records the review when the reviewer is dispatched
gh pr create --base main --title "Add refunds" --body-file body.md
# allowed: every critical task has a review after its last change
